description: This file contains unit tests for a Blazor application component, specifically testing rendering behavior based on user authentication and authorization states, navigations, and route handling.

classes.name: AppRenderTests
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests for ensuring correct rendering of the App component under various authentication and navigation scenarios.

methods.name: App_NotAuthenticated_AdminRoute_Renders_RedirectToLogin
methods.description: Tests that an unauthenticated user attempting to access the /admin route is redirected to login via RedirectToLogin component.

methods.name: App_Authorized_NotInRole_Shows_NotAuthorized_Message
methods.description: Verifies that a user authorized but without the necessary role sees a 'Not Authorized' message.

methods.name: App_Authorized_AdminRole_Renders_Admin_List_Page
methods.description: Ensures an authorized admin user with the proper role can see the admin list page content.

methods.name: App_UnknownRoute_Renders_NotFound_Message
methods.description: Checks that navigation to an unknown route renders the NotFound message.
